in_marathi.name: Prabir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bright, Shining One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prabir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Prabir is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prabhR' which means 'bright' or 'shining one'. This name is often given to babies born in Hindu families as a symbol of wisdom, intelligence, and the divine light of knowledge.
